title: Byzantine Church at Mukhmas
author: R. W. H[amilton]
location_note: North end of Mukhmas village, about four miles east of the Jerusalem-Ramallah road; no map reference; placed by name.
notes: Mosaic floor of a basilica (6th c. by style) with a Greek dedication of Valentinus, in a house yard. The only eligible feature is a cistern of the present village built over the church site (a church capital is built into a cistern).

features.site: north end of the village, on the church site
features.subtype: cistern built on the church site with re-used church capital (later village construction)
features.period: later than the church; built with the present village houses
features.quote: and a cistern have been constructed immediately on the site
